chunks: And (remember) Lot when he said to his people: "You indulge in lecherous acts which none of the creatures had done before you."

key_terms.لُوطًا: Lot (peace be upon him), the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What unique sin did Lot's people commit according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Ankabut, this verse highlights the Prophet Lot’s (peace be upon him) unique diagnostic of his people’s sin, noting that their specific act of sodomy was unprecedented in human history. Shia exegetes often contrast this with the general moral failings of other prophets' communities to emphasize the distinctiveness of the Sodomites' transgression. This serves as a foundational text for understanding divine justice regarding unique societal corruptions.
